 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Juventus will look to get back to winning ways against Lecce today, and this is the starting eleven chosen by Luciano Spalletti.
 Juventus team to face Lecce
 Juventus entered the season hoping to improve on their performances from the previous campaign, but they have so far failed to meet expectations. Their inconsistent form has raised concerns that they could finish the season in similarly disappointing fashion unless they find a way to turn things around.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Luciano Spalletti is working hard to improve results, making matches like this particularly important. Juventus need to collect points against teams such as Lecce, especially with stronger opponents waiting further along the schedule.
 Lecce can exploit Juventus' weaknesses
 Lecce will welcome the opportunity to face Juventus while the visitors are struggling for confidence. The home side will hope to use their opponents' defensive problems to create chances and put pressure on a team that has found it difficult to control matches consistently.
 In midweek, Juventus continued a worrying trend of conceding the opening goal. Their vulnerability at the back could give Lecce an opportunity to take control early and make life uncomfortable for Spalletti's men.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement However, Lecce will need to overcome a difficult recent record against Juve. In their last ten meetings, the home side has failed to win any matches and has lost seven of those encounters. That history underlines the challenge facing them, despite Juventus' current struggles.
 Juventus must respond under pressure
 For Juventus, the priority will be to regain confidence and avoid another performance that allows their opponents to dictate the game. Their defensive lapses have repeatedly made matches harder than necessary, and Spalletti will want his players to show greater concentration from the opening whistle.
 Lecce, meanwhile, have reason to believe this could be a valuable opportunity. Juventus remain a dangerous opponent, but their recent performances have exposed weaknesses that the hosts will look to exploit.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Although Lecce's record against Juventus makes this a difficult assignment, the visitors' poor form could give the home side renewed hope. If Lecce take advantage of Juventus' defensive uncertainty, they may have their best opportunity in some time to end their winless run against the Bianconeri.
